title: Claude Opus 4.7 General Availability
description: Anthropic's latest Opus model, Claude Opus 4.7, is now rolling out on GitHub Copilot. In early testing, Opus 4.7 delivers stronger multi-step task performance and more reliable agentic execution compared to previous versions.

title: Copilot CLI Auto Model Selection
description: Copilot auto model selection is now generally available in GitHub Copilot CLI for all Copilot plans. With auto mode, Copilot chooses the most efficient model on your behalf.

title: Manage Agent Skills with GitHub CLI
description: GitHub launched 'gh skill', a new command in the GitHub CLI that makes it easy to discover, install, and manage agent skills, which are reshaping how developers work with AI coding agents.

title: Model Selection for Claude and Codex Agents
description: Model selection is now available for the Claude and Codex third-party coding agents on github.com. Users can select a model when kicking off a coding agent task, similar to Copilot cloud agent.

title: Copilot Data Residency in US + EU and FedRAMP Compliance
description: GitHub Copilot now supports data residency for US and EU regions, ensuring all inference processing and associated data stay within the designated geography. For US government customers, all model hosts are now FedRAMP authorized.

title: Canvases Feature
description: Cursor can now respond by creating interactive canvases - visualizations that include dashboards and custom interfaces built using first-party components like tables, boxes, diagrams, and charts, as well as existing Cursor components like diffs and to-do lists. Canvases are durable artifacts that live in the side panel.

title: Aider v0.86.0 - GPT-5 and Grok-4 Support
description: Added support for all GPT-5 models and Grok-4 via xai/grok-4 and openrouter/x-ai/grok-4 model names. Also added support for gemini/gemini-2.5-flash-lite-preview-06-17 model and various improvements.

title: v1.3.38-vscode Release
description: Added support for filtering session history by workspace directory, .continue/configs support, and various dependency updates and security fixes including resolving critical and high security vulnerabilities.
